prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE landscape high-resolution pixel-art concept comparison board for JACK RUSSELL TERRIER head and short neck. This is the new fifth breed of the exact same series as reference1. Three rows A/B/C, five columns SIDE, 3-4, FRONT, BACK, TOP. Same calm warm ivory background, fine separators, pixel-font labels, layout and artwork scale as reference2. Title "JACK RUSSELL / B2 SOFT PIXEL"; footer "B SHAPE / STYLE STUDY".

INPUT ROLES: reference1 is canonical B2 STYLE only: imitate the exact apparent pixel density, restrained colored outline, big simple connected soft stepped shadow clusters and round small dark dot eyes, especially the Whippet and Maltipoo rows. reference2 ROW A is the user's approved shadow language and sheet style, NOT Golden anatomy. reference3 ROW B is the absolute JACK RUSSELL SHAPE authority, all five corresponding views. Ignore reference3 rows A and C. Trace/translate the low moderately flat cranium, long substantial but slightly tapering muzzle, restrained brow step, strong lower jaw, short supported neck and small forward-folded triangular BUTTON ears exactly from ROW B. Do not copy any reference1/2 breed's head shape. Do not turn this into a short-muzzled puppy, huge dome, beak, hanging retriever ears or upright pointy ears. Preserve relative placement of eyes, nose, ear root, ear tips; front/back/top must agree with side and 3/4. Same geometry in ALL A/B/C rows.

Coat is an AUTHORED generic concept, not a specific real dog: predominantly warm ivory-white face, muzzle, skull and short neck, with both small folded ears in warm muted tan. Keep tan confined to the ears so markings are completely consistent in all views, crown stays white. Nose and eyes dark brown-black. No mouth smile line, no collar, no body, no spots, no hair-strand texture. Soft restrained warm gray-beige shading on white, warm tan shadow inside ears; single muted brown outline hue, limited large color areas. Must look drawn by SAME pixel artist as the other breeds. Visible clean pixel staircase silhouette and soft stepped cluster shading, not smooth 3D, not vector, not glossy, not hard chunky black outline, not dithering. Upper-left lighting. Keep eyes rounded dark dot clusters, never cross/plus signs.

A = standard canonical B2 shadow coverage/contrast, close to approved Golden row A. B = subtly lighter and smaller shadow coverage only. C = subtly deeper and larger shadow coverage only. DO NOT vary coat markings, silhouette, muzzle length, nose, eye shape/placement, ear length between rows. All 15 cells fully visible with consistent scale and spacious separation. Art direction is a high-resolution concept, not a native64 or pixel-exact mesh projection claim.
scope: High-resolution concept. Jack model B geometry reference; canonical B2 plus selected Golden A style. Authored white coat with tan ears; no individual photo identity. No native64 claim.
